effects.title: Staggered reveal
effects.tagline: Children rise in sequence when the section enters the viewport.

effects.title: Deck spread
effects.tagline: A centered card deck deals itself into the grid. On arrival or scrubbed.

effects.title: Curtain
effects.tagline: Two panels slide apart as you scroll through a pinned stretch.

effects.title: Horizontal rail
effects.tagline: Vertical scroll travels a horizontal track through a pinned stage.

effects.title: Sequenced scrub
effects.tagline: Each child animates over its own slice of the pin. Choreography without a timeline.

effects.title: GSAP timeline under scrub
effects.tagline: Author the choreography in GSAP, let ScrollVars drive it. One listener, one writer.

effects.title: Three.js scene on the pin
effects.tagline: A WebGL scene scrubbed by scroll. The canvas harness runs the lifecycle, Three renders.

effects.title: Split reveal
effects.tagline: A headline broken into words, each rising on its own beat, SplitText without the engine.

effects.title: Rotating words
effects.tagline: One word exits up, the next rises from below. A clipped column on one variable.

effects.title: Pointer tilt
effects.tagline: Cards tilt toward the cursor with a moving glare. One delegated listener.

effects.title: Coverflow slider
effects.tagline: Native-scroll carousel; slides scale, fade and turn by their distance from center.

effects.title: Marquee
effects.tagline: An infinite strip (logos, taglines) that pauses on hover.

effects.title: Cinematic hero
effects.tagline: Split headline rising on a beat, pointer-parallax glow, a marquee strip, and the whole block fades out as you scroll past (--sv-t).

effects.title: Pinned timeline
effects.tagline: Pin the section; the scroll draws the line, counts the year and lights each milestone over its own slice of the pin.

effects.title: Sticky steps
effects.tagline: Media stays put while the copy scrolls; each step swaps the shot. The product-page pattern, with --sv-scene doing the swapping.

effects.title: Stats count-up
effects.tagline: Numbers count from zero when the block enters. CSS counters + a registered property. The transition IS the animation.

effects.title: Case-study rail
effects.tagline: Oversized project cards traverse a pinned stage with --sv-pin; long content returns to a readable list.

effects.title: Editorial manifesto
effects.tagline: Big statements gain contrast in sequence as --sv-t advances. Natural document flow, no pin and no split spans.

effects.title: Cube windows
effects.tagline: A box turns in 3D as the section scrolls by and tilts to the pointer; its outline becomes the clip-path of the photo inside. The photo itself never moves.
